source_snapshot.test_set: Intel GNR CPU RAS - Runtime Post Package Repair
source_snapshot.procedure: Enable Runtime PPR/Row Sparing, threshold1, trigger threshold and per-row threshold2; halt/reset injector; inject CE at0x8000 and go twice; prove serial 1/2 then reached threshold, runtime soft PPR invocation, FTrace extlog_mem_event and exact token extmem_log_event.
source_snapshot.criteria: Serial shows BIOS invoked runtime soft PPR and completed repair.

source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 3. The following BIOS settings paths are from the Intel reference platform. Locations of these settings may be different on your BIOS implementation Customer Scripts (CScripts) Enabling The following is a quick reference of the key BIOS knobs for CScripts: • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > Lock Chipset = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > MSR Lock Control = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > IIO Configuration > DFX Global Configuration > — EV DFX Features = Enable — Disable BIOS Done = [X] ELOG Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > eMCA Settings > — EMCA Error Support= Enable — EMCA Logging Support= Enable — Corrected Error eLog = Enable — Memory Error eLog = Enable — Processor Error eLog = Enable Error Reporting Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > WHEA Settings > — WHEA Support = Enable — WHEA Log Memory Error = Enable — WHEA Log Processor Error = Enable — WHEA Log PCI Error = Enable Error Injection Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — System Errors = Enable — System Memory Poison = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Error Injection Settings > — MCA Bank Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Action Table = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > — IIO/PCH Global Error Support = Enable — IIO MCA Support = Disable — IIO eDPC Support = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe* Corrected Error Threshold Counter = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe AER Corrected Errors = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > LMCE Support = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Memory Error Enabling > Memory Corrected Error = Enable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Uncore Configuration > Uncore General Configuration > Directory Mode Enable = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > Enable DAM Pin = Enable Firmware First Model • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > — EMCA Logging Support = Enable — EMCA CMCI-SMI Morphing = EMCA gen2 CSMI — EMCA CMCI-SMI Threshold = 0 — EMCA MCA-SMI Enable = EMCA gen 2 - MSMI • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > OS Native AER Support = Disable Crash Log • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > CPU CrashLog Feature = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > PCH CrashLog Feature = Disable 4. Other OS Notes You can use grub2-mkconfig to specify "ras=cec_disable" by modifying /etc/default/grub's "GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX" with "ras=cec_disable". 【During Test】 1. Runtime Soft PPR specific BIOS setup : • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Memory Configuration > Memory RAS Configuration > — Runtime PPR/Row Sparing = Enable — Correctable Error Threshold = 1 — Trigger SW Error Threshold = Enable — SW Per Row Threshold = 2 • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — RAS Log Level = MID (BASIC_FLOW, FUNC_FLOW) • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > — Serial Debug Message Level = Normal NOTE sPPR is experiencing issues such as sightings report issue #120. BIOS/BMC developers can continue with development by temporarily bypassing the issue by turning off data scrambling. 2. Halt the system and reset the injectors. >>> halt() >>> ei.utils.resetInjectorLockCheck() 3. Inject a correctable error then resume the system so BIOS can log the DIMM error record. >>> ei.mem.injectMemError(0x8000, errType="ce") >>> go() 4. Observe in serial log that the SW Row Threshold counter is at 1/2. 5. Verify in FTrace logs that an ELog event was recorded indicated by extlog_mem_event. 6. Repeat the last step so you reach the SW row threshold counter. >>> ei.mem.injectMemError(0x8000, errType="ce") >>> go() 7. Confirm in serial log that the SW row threshold was reached. 8. Observe in serial log that BIOS invoked runtime soft PPR to complete the repair. 9. Verify in FTrace logs that an ELog event was recorded indicated by extmem_log_event.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: Serial log that BIOS invoked runtime soft PPR to complete the repair.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Runtime Soft PPR (Intel Runtime Soft PPR Runtime Soft PPR error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'ppr|package.repair|corrected|uncorrected'; echo __Runtime_Soft_PPR_Runtime_Soft_PPR; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.test_name: Runtime Soft PPR — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate that two correctable errors on the same intended GNR DRAM row reach the runtime threshold and cause BIOS to perform and complete Runtime Soft PPR while the system remains in the runtime flow.
required_package: GNR stepping, BIOS/BMC/OS and DIMM/row identity
Expected 1/2 and reached serial fields, extlog_mem_event, exact extmem_log_event and runtime repair completion fields
Decision whether issue#120 affects this firmware and exact approved scrambling knob/scope/security impact/rollback if required
Crash/OOB recovery, no-retry and final repaired-row health oracle
test_case.test_command: Record platform/DIMM topology, harness, settings and data-scrambling baseline; apply the source Runtime PPR and threshold matrix; map address0x8000 to one approved row; preserve logs; execute exactly one CE/go and capture 1/2 plus extlog; execute the second identical CE/go and capture threshold, runtime repair and exact extmem_log_event; prove no boot-time reset substituted for runtime action, verify repaired-row/health state, and restore all debug/PPR plus any explicitly approved workaround.
test_case.expected_result: Serial log that BIOS invoked runtime soft PPR to complete the repair.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for Runtime Soft PPR.
